What are the main limitations of Monte Carlo methods? Episode-based learning: • Only works for episodic tasks • Must wait for episode completion to update • No online learning during episodes • Can be slow if episodes are long High variance: • Sample returns can vary greatly • Especially problematic in off-policy methods • May need many episodes for good estimates • Importance sampling can make variance worse
